LESSON: ULUMUL HADITH • FORMS OF HADITH • COMPONENTS OF HADITH • TYPES OF HADITH • IMPORTANCE OF HADITH

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Hadith
Topic 2.1: Ulumul Hadith • forms of Hadith • components of Hadith • types of Hadith • importance of Hadith
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Ulumul Hadith • forms of Hadith • components of Hadith • types of Hadith • importance of Hadith, part of Hadith in Grade 7 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: Why is Hadith important in the life of a Muslim?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. search online/on available reference materials on the meaning of hadith,

2. discuss the components of Hadith and present in class,

3. research on forms of Hadith and prepare a chart for display,

4. research on types of Hadith (Nabawy and Qudsy) and make a class presentation,

5. discuss the differences between Hadith Qudsy and Nabawy and share in class

6. research on the importance of hadith from available reference materials and make notes,

7. identify and use available networks to access and share information on the sifat of the Prophet (S.A.W.).

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. search online/on available reference materials on the meaning of hadith,
2. discuss the components of Hadith and present in class,
3. research on forms of Hadith and prepare a chart for display,
4. research on types of Hadith (Nabawy and Qudsy) and make a class presentation,
5. discuss the differences between Hadith Qudsy and Nabawy and share in class
6. research on the importance of hadith from available reference materials and make notes,
7. identify and use available networks to access and share information on the sifat of the Prophet (S.A.W.).

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Ulumul Hadith • forms of Hadith • components of Hadith • types of Hadith • importance of Hadith together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Critical thinking and Problem-solving: the learners identify and use available networks to access and share information on

the sifat of the Prophet (S.A.W.).

• Creativity and Imagination: communication and self-expression as learners artistically prepare charts on forms of Hadith for

display.

• Digital Literacy: skills of digital citizenship as the learner observes safety precautions and practises when using digital

devices.

Values:
• Unity: as learners cooperate to work as a team to prepare charts on forms of Hadith for display.

• Respect: patience as they appreciate diverse opinions during discussions in groups.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Life Skills: effective communication skills as learners research and make class presentations.

Link to other Subjects:

English and Kiswahili: the learner can apply the listening, speaking, and writing skills in English and Kiswahili.
